summary.text: In his role as OSTP Director, Michael Kratsios described America’s AI Action Plan as charting a course to cement U.S. dominance in AI and as a strategy for winning the AI race based on innovation, infrastructure, and international partnerships. He has promoted sharing the American AI stack with international partners, including through the American AI Exports Program, while stating that the U.S. rejects global governance of AI. He has advocated use-case and sector-specific AI regulation rather than one-size-fits-all or centralized regulatory regimes. He has described the Genesis Mission as a flagship whole-of-nation effort and as a whole-of-government effort to apply AI to science across more than 15 federal agencies.
